title: 第24章 搬运工第25章 卓杰的过去人生
lines: 午后，晚春的太阳高悬，暖洋洋的日光洒落，行走在日头底下的人们不免感到一丝燥热。
夏季将近了。
平安花苑6栋单元楼前，一只手掌推开了单元楼的大门，苏午背着一箱箱用绳带捆好的重物，矮身踏出大门。
他背后足足有五个大箱子，因箱内物品较为充实，挤压得纸箱往外膨出了不少。
阳光照得苏午微微眯眼。
他拿手遮了遮眼，听到对面单元楼前的喧哗声，自然而然往对面3号单元楼门前投去目光。
3号单元楼下停了两辆警车、一辆医院救护车。
不少人聚集在楼下，在他们的喧哗吵闹声中，几位医护人员将三个鼓囊囊的装尸袋抬进了救护车中。
救护车随即开走了。
人群的喧闹仍在继续。
生活在这附近，甚至本身就是3号单元楼住户的人们脸色沉凝，互相低声交谈着。
“不到一个小时，三个人全莫名其妙地死了！”
“听说死得都很惨，有两个人好像是被直接砍成了碎肉……”
“我这里有照片……”
“这里住不得了，咱俩倒没关系，孩子们还小，万一他们被凶手盯上了就麻烦大了，先搬家吧——今天就搬！
这几天晚上现在旅馆里对付对付……”
“那个搬家APP叫什么啊？”
苏午听着楼底下人们的交谈声，眼神幽深。
记事本上说今天3号单元楼会发生3起凶杀案，而今已得到验证。
影诡开始苏醒了。
从现在开始的每一分每一秒都渐渐不安全起来。
它刚刚复苏的时候，力量还不是特别稳定，只是随机杀死了3号楼里的三个住户。
到15号夜间，杀死那一对情侣后，影诡便会全面复苏。
力量覆盖整个平安花苑，只要任何人周围出现影子，它都会迅速降临，将人逐个杀死。
苏午叹了一口气。
他已经在平安花苑租户大群里发出过提醒，但是被群里聊骚的、求涩图的各种消息给淹没了。
没人注意他说过什么。
如果苏午频繁在聊天群里发出这种消息，可能还没等到诡异复苏，他就会先被带到医院精神科检查检查了。
苏午紧了紧肩膀上的绳带，迈步朝前走。
现在他连自身的安全都无法保障，哪有资格去向别人施惠？他所能做的不过是在能力范围内多提醒别人两句而已。
更何况，现实中也有专门应对诡异的工作人员。
譬如自己在模拟里查看群消息，看到那个头像一片漆黑，却被官方认证的账号，在租户群里发出的严词提醒。
那个人应该就是专门应对诡异的工作人员。
他们都还未出动，自己着急有什么用？
苏午背着东西向前走着，路过2号单元楼下，一个搬运工正背着一台旧单门冰箱走出大楼门。
那人头发斑白，面色黧黑，看起来已经上了年纪。
其单手扶着背后的冰箱，另一只手推开大楼门，刚迈出大楼门的脚忽然颤了一下！
背后的冰箱登时向一侧歪倒，带着那人的身体向一侧倾斜！
苏午离得很近，眼看冰箱就要歪下来，极可能把那人也砸伤，他朝侧前方急迈出两步，一手伸出，正好抵在冰箱的侧边。
冰箱带着人侧倾的力量都压到了他的左手上。
content_en:
In the afternoon, the late spring sun hangs high, and the warm sunlight shines down. People walking under the sun can't help but feel a little bit hot.
Summer is almost here.
In front of the 6 unit building of Ping'an Garden, a palm pushed open the door of the unit building. Su Wu stepped out of the door carrying boxes of heavy objects tied with ropes.
There are five large boxes behind him. Because the items in the boxes are relatively large, the cartons bulge out a lot when squeezed.
The sunlight made Su Wu squint slightly.
He covered his eyes with his hands, and when he heard the noise in front of the unit building opposite, he naturally cast his gaze in front of the door of Unit 3 opposite.
Two police cars and a hospital ambulance were parked downstairs in Unit 3.
Many people gathered downstairs, and amid their noise, several medical staff carried three bulging body bags into the ambulance.
The ambulance then drove away.
The roar of the crowd continued.
People living nearby, and even residents of Unit 3, looked solemn and talked to each other in low voices.
"In less than an hour, all three people died inexplicably!"
"I heard that they died miserably. Two people seemed to have been chopped into pieces..."
"I have photos here..."
"We can't live here. It doesn't matter to us. The children are still young. If they are targeted by the murderer, they will be in big trouble. Let's move first - move today!
These days, I’m going to deal with it in the hotel these nights…”
“What’s the name of that moving app?”
…
Su Wu listened to the conversations of people downstairs with deep eyes.
The notepad said that three murders would occur in Unit 3 today, and now it has been verified.
Shadow Quiet started to wake up.
Every second from now on becomes less and less safe.
When it first revived, its power was not particularly stable, and it only randomly killed three residents in Building 3.
On the night of the 15th, after killing the couple, the shadow will be fully revived.
The power covers the entire Peace Garden. As long as a shadow appears around anyone, it will quickly come down and kill them one by one.
Su Wu sighed.
He had already sent out a reminder to the large group of tenants of Ping An Garden, but was inundated by all kinds of messages from the group chatting about sex and asking for sexy pictures.
No one paid attention to what he said.
If Su Wu frequently sends such messages in the chat group, he may be taken to the hospital for psychiatric examination before Wei Wei recovers.
Su Wu tightened the rope around her shoulders and stepped forward.
Now that he can't even protect his own safety, how can he be qualified to benefit others? All he can do is to remind others a few more words within his ability.
What's more, in reality, there are also staff who specialize in dealing with weird things.
For example, when I checked the group messages in the simulation, I saw that the avatar was dark, but the officially certified account issued a stern reminder in the tenant group.
That person should be a staff member who specializes in dealing with weird things.
They haven't moved out yet, so what's the use of being anxious?
Su Wu walked forward carrying her things and passed by the downstairs of Unit 2. A porter was walking out of the building carrying an old single-door refrigerator.
The man had gray hair and a swarthy complexion, and looked old.
He held the refrigerator behind his back with one hand and pushed open the building door with the other hand. His feet suddenly trembled as he stepped out of the building door!
The refrigerator behind him immediately tilted to one side, along with the man's body!
Su Wu was very close, and when he saw that the refrigerator was about to tip over, possibly injuring the man, he took two quick steps to the side, stretched out one hand, and hit the side of the refrigerator.
The force of the refrigerator carrying the person's tilting was on his left hand.
title_en: Chapter 24 Porter Chapter 25 Zhuo Jie’s past life
